text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here it is! The sky is clear and high 
as the Umamusume roar for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on these four Umamusume, of 
course! They enter one after another to 
thunderous cheers!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! The Overlord of the End of the 
Century stands before you!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, we shall seize a one-two finish! If, 
by any chance, my strength should give 
out—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No, never mind! Regardless, let us march 
forth!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hai-eeee, Opera O-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, let's do our best! Believing in 
all the time we've spent building up 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you have any concerns, we should 
address them while we—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine. You're overthinking it. Focus 
on yourself instead.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Man, this autumn feels straight out of 
Figaro. Pleased to work with you, Top 
Road-san, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Shall we put on the greatest race of all? 
For the crowd, and for "those ones."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Those ones...? Opera O-chan, who do you 
mean by 'those ones'...?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, never mind. We'll find out soon 
enough.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Regardless, there's no need to hold back 
at all! Come at this matinee performance 
ready to burn it all out in a single 
stage!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I haven't held back even once since 
the day I was born! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clenching my fists, I watch over the 
paddock. And by my side...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Come on, over here, over here. You won't 
want to miss this today.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El isn't here, so let's just enjoy 
ourselves with the rest of us.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks, Grass-chan! I've got to 
cheer hard enough to make up for not 
racing much lately!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Do yer best, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though disguised behind charming Hokkaido 
dialect, her true identity is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leader of the Golden Generation. Winner of 
the Japan Derby, she is a legendary 
Umamusume hailed as the "Supreme Commander 
of Japan."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the other is Grass Wonder of the 
Golden Generation. A foreign-born Yamato 
Nadeshiko and a Grand Prix Umamusume who 
conquered the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them had recently stepped away 
from the front lines, but... they went out 
of their way to come check on things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Autumn of the Senior Class. The world 
surrounding Narita Top Road is expanding 
even further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto's awakening. Furthermore, the 
Golden Generation has begun to move. This 
race looks set to become a turning point.
